<?php
class InheritedStorageParent37 {
    public int $value = 100 {
        get {
            echo "P:", __CLASS__, "/", static::class, "|";
            return $this->value + 1;
        }
    }
    public function parentRead() { return $this->value; }
}
class InheritedStorageChild37 extends InheritedStorageParent37 {
    public int $value { get => $this->answer(); }
    private function answer() {
        echo "C:", __CLASS__, "/", static::class, "|";
        return 7;
    }
}
class InheritedStorageGrand37 extends InheritedStorageChild37 {
    private function answer() { echo "BADGRAND|"; return 99; }
}
class InheritedStorageUntypedParent37 {
    public $value = "seed" { get { return $this->value; } }
}
class InheritedStorageUntypedChild37 extends InheritedStorageUntypedParent37 {
    public $value { get => false; }
}
$parent = new InheritedStorageParent37;
$result = $parent->value;
echo "P", $result, ":", ((array)$parent === ["value" => 100] ? "ONE|" : "BAD|");
$child = new InheritedStorageChild37;
echo ((array)$child === [] ? "CE|" : "BAD|");
$result = $child->value;
echo "C", $result, "|";
$grand = new InheritedStorageGrand37;
echo ((array)$grand === [] ? "GE|" : "BAD|");
$result = $grand->parentRead();
echo "T", $result, "|";
$grand->value = 300;
echo ((array)$grand === ["value" => 300] ? "ONE300|" : "BAD|");
$result = $grand->value;
echo "W", $result, "|";
$untyped = new InheritedStorageUntypedChild37;
echo ((array)$untyped === ["value" => null] ? "NULLSLOT|" : "BAD|");
$result = $untyped->value;
echo ($result === false ? "FALSE|" : "BAD|");
$untyped->value = 5;
echo ((array)$untyped === ["value" => 5] ? "ONE5|" : "BAD|");

<?php
class InheritedStorageLeaf37 {
    public $tag;
    public function __destruct() { echo "D", $this->tag, "|"; }
}
function inheritedStorageFresh37() {
    global $weak_returned;
    echo "G|";
    $leaf = new InheritedStorageLeaf37;
    $leaf->tag = "R";
    $weak_returned = WeakReference::create($leaf);
    return $leaf;
}
class InheritedStorageLifeParent37 {
    public mixed $value = 100 { get { return $this->value; } }
    public function parentRead() { return $this->value; }
    public function __destruct() {
        $raw = (array)$this;
        $leaf = $raw["value"];
        echo "B", $leaf->tag, "|";
    }
}
class InheritedStorageLifeChild37 extends InheritedStorageLifeParent37 {
    public mixed $value { get => inheritedStorageFresh37(); }
}
class InheritedStorageLifeGrand37 extends InheritedStorageLifeChild37 {}
$box = new InheritedStorageLifeGrand37;
$weak_box = WeakReference::create($box);
echo ((array)$box === [] ? "EMPTY|" : "BAD|");
$stored = new InheritedStorageLeaf37;
$stored->tag = "S";
$weak_stored = WeakReference::create($stored);
$box->value = $stored;
unset($stored);
echo "STORED|";
$kept = $box->parentRead();
echo "HELD|";
unset($box);
echo ($weak_box->get() === null ? "BN|" : "BL|");
echo ($weak_stored->get() === null ? "SN|" : "SL|");
echo ($weak_returned->get() === null ? "RN|" : "LIVE|");
unset($kept);
echo ($weak_returned->get() === null ? "RN|" : "LIVE|");
